description: The factoryd container started 3 times or more within the last 10 minutes: the kubelet's Started events of a pod of the Deployment factoryd, each start counted once by the event's own time (a crash restart and a replaced pod each start the container once and move that time, a copy SigNoz stores twice keeps it; the Deployment runs one replica). It clears by itself 10 minutes after the last start.

annotations.summary: container starts in the last 10 minutes

filter.expression: attribute.k8s.event.reason = 'Started' AND resource.k8s.object.kind = 'Pod' AND resource.k8s.object.name LIKE 'factoryd-%' AND resource.k8s.object.fieldpath = 'spec.containers{factoryd}'
